transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Yeah, nice to meet you. Um... mostly just having some issues at work. 

I'll start a safety briefing or a plan review, really trying to pay attention, but... within a few minutes, my mind is just off on three other job problems. I end up missing things I know I should've caught. So... yeah. That's what brings me in.
Did you have this same kind of trouble paying attention when you were a child?

Yeah... I guess so. Um... even back in elementary school, the teachers were already telling my parents about it. Saying I couldn't stay in my seat, or... that I talked out of turn. Just stuff like that. I'd lose my homework a lot, or just... rush through the directions before I really understood what I was supposed to be doing. So... yeah.
Do these attention problems also cause trouble for you outside of work?

Yeah, um... it's not just work. I mean, work is bad right now. My boss actually had to pull me aside... said I was missing too many follow-ups and messing up the site coordination. So there's that. But, uh... at home, too. My wife... she's pretty tired of it. I'll tell her I'm gonna handle something, and then I just... don't. She has to keep reminding me. So, yeah. It causes trouble there, too.
When you're not feeling especially stressed or worried, do you still have the same trouble paying attention?
Yeah, pretty much. I mean... even when things are fine, it's still hard to focus. It doesn't really matter if I'm stressed or not, it's just... always kind of like that.
